models.description: D15-P2 8-cell P2Dlite-RG precision benchmark model; tests transfer from cross-batch 8-cell calibration set to ALL55.
D15-P3C Batch-2 15-cell closed-set model; tests whether the Batch-2 stress-test model is batch-specific or transferable.

notes: This stage does not train a new model and does not modify soft labels.
P2Dlite-RG labels remain model-consistent soft labels, not experimental internal-state truth.
The default one-hot fallback for profiles unseen by a closed-set model is all-zero onehot; seen/unseen groups are reported separately.
If no existing model transfers well to ALL55, the next step should be ALL55 unified NN training or batch/protocol-aware expert design.
